messages:
Priya (Finance): Heads-up: Partner Solvera reported an unexpected credit on their March statement. They say it looks like a promo credit was applied twice.
Jun (Acct Lead): I pulled INV-2026-0789. There are two lines that look identical: PROMO-APR-2026 $1,200 applied twice. Customer says they only qualified once.
Liam (Billing Ops): Hm. We ran the promo backfill job last weekend. Maybe the job retried and re-applied credits. I'll check the job run id and idempotency.
Liam (Billing Ops): Grep from billing logs for acct slv-422: 
```
2026-04-04T11:03:02Z promo-backfill job=promo-backfill run=rb-20260404 attempts=1 svc=billing apply_credit acct=slv-422 promo=PROMO-APR-2026 amt=1200 code=PROMO-APR-2026
2026-04-04T11:03:02Z promo-backfill job=promo-backfill run=rb-20260404 attempts=2 svc=billing apply_credit acct=slv-422 promo=PROMO-APR-2026 amt=1200 code=PROMO-APR-2026
```
Jun (Acct Lead): That definitely shows duplicate application - weird that attempts=1 and attempts=2 both logged.
Priya (Finance): OK. Policy is to issue a reversal for accidental duplicate promo credits. Create a reversing adjustment for $1,200 and note "duplicate promo-backfill". Also document for postmortem.
Liam (Billing Ops): I'll create reversal using vb adjust-reversal: 
```
vb adjust-reversal --acct slv-422 --amount 1200 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-0789 --reason "duplicate promo-backfill" --code REV-PROMO
```
refund-bot: Action queued: reversal_pending | id=BILL-5190 | acct=slv-422 | amt=1200 USD
Jun (Acct Lead): Before we post reversal, Jun: should we notify the customer? Sometimes customers get concerned when credits vanish.
Priya (Finance): Yes, we should notify. Keep the message clear: explain it was applied in error and the reversal will appear as a debit on the next invoice, not as an immediate charge. Offer to walk through the statement.
Liam (Billing Ops): Reversal posted: txn=RV-2026-33F1. Notes added to INV-2026-0789 referencing BILL-5190 and root cause tag rc=promo-backfill-idempotency. refund-bot: Action completed: reversal | id=BILL-5190 | status=completed | txn=RV-2026-33F1
Jun (Acct Lead): Message sent to partner: "Hi Solvera — we discovered a duplicate promo credit on INV-2026-0789 caused by a backfill job retry. We've posted a reversal of $1,200 (txn RV-2026-33F1). This will show on your next statement as a reversal line. Sorry for the confusion; we're fixing the job to be idempotent. — Jun"
Priya (Finance): Thanks. Closing on finance side after ledger reconciles. Liam, please add the postmortem card to the pricing-experiments board and include suggested mitigation: add idempotency token and dedupe check on promo-backfill.
